bio: Dutchman Marcel Koolen has taken charge of the kitchen at this stylishly urban restaurant (housed in 7132 Hotel, a heritage building that is a magnet for design and architecture fans). With the support of his international team and executive chef Matthias Schmidberger, he proposes highly creative cuisine that features harmonious contrasts and accentuates the natural flavours of the wonderful ingredients. Dishes are pared down to the essentials with stunning results. Take, for example, the hake, cooked on a binchotan charcoal grill and accompanied by the characteristic earthiness of a stuffed morel, a buttery morel cream and a drizzle of herb oil. The Menu Surprise also comes in a vegetarian version. Wine or house-made alcohol-free pairings available. The front-of-house team is professional...
